categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Modifies the functional test framework's secp256k1 implementation and carries the Tests label.
categories.rationale: Optimizing test framework secp256k1 multiplication speeds up `feature_taproot.py` by ~38% and fixed-base multiplication ~4x, according to the PR description and commit 8d1c38ca88. While test execution speed directly benefits CI and contributor iteration times, performance improvements to individual test utilities are worthwhile but deferrable relative to flaky test fixes or framework capabilities.
